name: Campos do Jordão (Brazil)
description: Green field divided into eight triangular quarters by a red cross and saltire fimbriated in white, charged at the centre with a white rectangle bearing the municipal arms reading 1874 CAMPOS DO JORDÃO 1934.
history: Campos do Jordão is a mountain resort municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag, designed by Arcinoé Antonio Peixoto de Faria, was prescribed by Municipal Law No. 793 of 2 May 1960 and first hoisted on 29 April 1969; the white rectangle stands for the town as seat and the arms for the municipal government, green for hope and abundance and white for peace. The arms, designed by Salvador Thaumaturgo, date from Law No. 251 of 1 January 1959.
